subject: Proposal: pace reset and conditional eval gate — TelosHealth MAP
messages:
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Gomez <agomez@teloshealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Subject: Proposal: pace reset and conditional eval gate — TelosHealth MAP

Hi Alicia,

Thanks again for the candid procurement update this morning. Based on the new procurement gating timeline you shared (internal review pushed to Aug 20), we propose a modest pace reset for the remaining MAP milestones to keep the program health-positive without losing momentum.

Proposed changes (high level):
- Move SOW signature target from Aug 18 -> Aug 25 (5 business days buffer for procurement exceptions)
- Move first integration week to Aug 30 — Sep 3
- Hold the full production canary to Sep 20 (gives us a 2-week quality window after integration)

To reduce your risk and keep the evaluation meaningful, Redwood will:
- Provide a one-time setup credit (conditional approval requested from my manager; we expect to confirm by EOD Aug 17)
- Deliver a SOC2 snapshot and an audit-logs extract for the eval period (attached)
- Guarantee a 99.5% availability SLO for the canary period, with a rollback/fallback plan documented in the MAP workbook

Ask: please confirm by EOD Aug 17 whether TelosHealth can accept the adjusted targets above. If you need a firmer commitment on credits/SLA we can escalate internally — I’ve CC’d Sales Ops (Karthik) and your Redwood lead for rapid review.

Attachments: MAP_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet), SOC2_snapshot.pdf (pdf)

Next steps if approved: I’ll send an updated MAP and a short checklist for procurement to attach to the SOW.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0189

Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2026 11:24:00 -0500
From: Alicia Gomez <agomez@teloshealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Carlos Mendes <c.mendes@teloshealthprocurement.com>
Subject: Re: Proposal: pace reset and conditional eval gate — TelosHealth MAP

Vanessa,

Appreciate the quick follow. Two points from procurement:
- We cannot move SOW signature past Aug 20 without a written exec-level exception. Our legal window for Q3 credits closes Aug 22.
- A verbal offer of a credit is not sufficient for procurement — they need an approved credit memo or PO attachment.

From TelosHealth leadership: they liked the SOC2 snapshot but need a short note on log retention length and query access (who at Telos can request extracts during the eval). Also need a firm SLA number in the contract (not a “we expect” statement).

If Redwood can provide the credit memo template + SOC2 extract retention statement by EOD Aug 17, procurement will fast-track to Aug 20. Otherwise we risk slipping to late September.

Alicia
Director, Clinical Integrations | TelosHealth
agomez@teloshealth.com

Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2026 13:02:00 -0700
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Subject: RE: Proposal: pace reset and conditional eval gate — TelosHealth MAP (internal escalation)

Vanessa / Marissa —

Summary: Telos needs a formal credit memo and a short retention/access statement for audit logs by EOD Aug 17 to keep SOW signature on Aug 20. If we miss that date we move the deal risk from Moderate -> High and likely push the close into late Sep.

Ask: I need an exec approval for a one-time onboarding credit (we discussed $20k in the pipeline call last week) and permission to sign an SLA clause for the canary (99.5% availability for the first 30 days) with a standard incident credit (pro rata). Approving these will let Vanessa send a procurement-ready package.

Risk log (condensed):
- Risk: Procurement window mismatch -> Impact: delayed SOW -> Severity: High -> Mitigation: credit memo + SOC2 extracts + SLA clause -> Owner: Sales Ops
- Risk: Integration resource availability -> Impact: delayed integration -> Severity: Medium -> Mitigation: reserve integration slot Aug 30-Sep 3 (contingent on SOW) -> Owner: Solutions Eng (Marissa)

If you approve, I’ll draft the credit memo and the SLA language and circulate for legal sign-off. We have until COB Aug 17 to get docs to Telos. Please reply with APPROVE / DENY (explicit) so I have a clear trail for procurement.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Sales Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

Date: Tue, 17 Aug 2026 08:05:00 -0700
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Gomez <agomez@teloshealth.com>, Carlos Mendes <c.mendes@teloshealthprocurement.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Subject: Re: Proposal: pace reset and conditional eval gate — TelosHealth MAP

Hi Alicia / Carlos —

Thanks for the clarity. Short answers up front: we can provide the credit memo and the SOC2 retention/access statement today; Sales Ops has submitted a request for a one-time $20k setup credit to my manager and Legal for approval. We will provide a draft credit memo and the SLA clause for your procurement packet by 5pm PT today (links below).

Confirmed commitments for the procurement packet (to be attached to the SOW):
- Credit memo (conditional on final exec sign-off) — attached draft
- SOC2 snapshot + retention statement: retention of 90 days for raw audit logs; TelosHealth security contacts will receive query access via an authenticated export mechanism (details in the attached doc)
- SLA language: 99.5% availability for the 30-day canary with standard incident credit; legal to confirm final phrasing.

If procurement confirms that will be sufficient to keep Aug 20 as the SOW signature target, we’ll lock the integration start window Aug 30-Sep 3 and reserve Marissa’s team for the integration kickoff. If we receive sign-off on Aug 20, final sign-off will be Sep 7 for the production canary.

Attachments: procurement_requirements.docx (docx), MAP_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Next steps: Carlos / Alicia — can you confirm by 4pm ET today that the draft credit memo + retention note meet procurement needs? If yes, we’ll route documents to Legal for the final stamp and share DocuSign links.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.ai
